purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0099 in the gauge arena: three cyclic values per link under a deterministic reversible rule reproduce Z3 confinement at high energy and the first-order coexistence of its transition, and freeze at low energy, where the ordered phase needs a kinetic variable.
